limits: Source-backed actionable means attributable candidate text exists, not complete body/ABI/oracle admission.
Needs joint fixture includes partial/manual sources or original local body with unverified lower state.
Lacks attributable source means no exact source identified in audited local corpus, not a proof that no source exists anywhere.
No stock executable bytes, addresses as function pointers, or unproved wrappers admitted.
corpus_match_method: Exact original entry searched in local source-reference.json, function-bindings.json and SOURCE_PROVENANCE.json under g2; semantic name cross-check in pinned Ambiq source; local historical alias blockers reviewed separately.
